themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Articles discussing AI agents designed to autonomously perform research tasks, from data collection and analysis to generating hypotheses and conducting experiments.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools that help developers write, debug, review, and optimize code, accelerating the software development lifecycle.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Covers AI applications used in the design process, including generating UI elements, exploring design aesthetics, and aiding in the creation of user interfaces.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Articles about various AI-powered tools used broadly for research, encompassing data analysis, information gathering, and insight generation across disciplines.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Focuses on AI capabilities that condense large amounts of text, such as articles, meeting transcripts, or research papers, into concise summaries.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Discusses the creation and use of artificial user profiles or data for testing, simulation, and research purposes.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Articles exploring the behavior, effectiveness, and potential risks associated with AI chatbots, particularly in user interactions and information provision.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Covers the application of AI in evaluating the ease of use and user experience of products and services, often through automated checks or simulated user interactions.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Focuses on AI techniques and tools used to analyze customer data, feedback, and behavior to derive actionable insights for business strategy and product development.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Discusses how AI is changing the job market, including job creation, displacement, skill requirements, and the overall impact on the human workforce.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
